Desc.SourceString: 休息好了！薄荷选手活力满满！
Desc.LocalizedString: All rested up! Player Mint is fully charged!
Let's get going if you're all rested up!

Desc.SourceString: 感觉会鉴定出好东西哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Something good is gonna come out of this!
If only there'd be something good.
I hope luck is on my side.

Desc.SourceString: 我许过愿啦——「千万要鉴定出好宝贝」！
Desc.LocalizedString: I made a wish to get treasures from my appraisals!

Desc.SourceString: 要不要施展一个保证获得好东西的法术呢？不过，这样会变得没意思呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Should I cast a spell to guarantee a good item from appraising? Hmm, that'd be boring though.

Desc.SourceString: 感觉就像开盲盒一样。能不能开出隐藏款？
Desc.LocalizedString: This is like a blind box. Are there secret editions too?
